biggest_catch: TestingTime's official pay figure is stated only as an average in EUR/CHF/GBP — 'On average, you earn €40 / CHF 50 / £50 per study' — with no USD figure, no official timestamped conversion, and no official session-duration band, so the schema's required numeric USD payout and time fields cannot be filled honestly.
catches: Official payout is an average stated in EUR/CHF/GBP only; no USD figure and no official timestamped conversion exists.
An average is not a concrete per-study payout — actual pay varies by study type and length.
No official session-duration band is published.
Invitations depend on profile match and are first-come, first-served; no volume guaranteed.
Most in-person tests are Europe-based; remote options vary by study.

c1.evidence: Official become-a-tester page describes the tester program and its pay FAQ (testingtime.com/en/become-a-tester/).

c2.evidence: Official pay is 'On average, you earn €40 / CHF 50 / £50 per study' — an average in non-USD currencies, not a concrete USD payout; no official timestamped conversion available.

c3.evidence: Official timing exists ('Payments are sent within 10 business days of the completed study'), but without a concrete USD payout and duration the route cannot verify.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; official page says 'No requirements needed.'

eligibility: Profile-based matching; email invitations; first-come, first-served; reliable and punctual attendance
maximize: Do not present TestingTime as a concrete-paying route — its official pay is an average in EUR/CHF/GBP with per-study amounts only shown during booking. Only join studies whose listed compensation and duration you accept in writing.
